humanAuthorization.authorizationStatement: APPROVED — AUTHORIZE CG-AIO-LAUNDRY-COMBO-DISCOVERY. Fit-test architectural_divergence accepted; single-witness limitation is a constraint on generalization, not permission to over-generalize.

coreConstraint: Discovery proposes minimum functional responsibilities required for AIO laundry-combo diagnostics — not OEM component lists. Samsung WD53 establishes candidate architecture only; it does not establish manufacturer-independent canonical truth without corroboration.

immutableFitInputs.policy: Read-only — discovery must not mutate fit artifacts

discoveryRules: Functional responsibilities only — no manufacturer-specific component ontology.
No component promotion merely because a component is novel.
Preserve existing frozen laundry concepts where they genuinely fit — reuse front_load_washer wash domains by reference, do not duplicate.
Identify only functional domains that cannot be represented by existing frozen contracts.
Prefer reusable functional boundaries over implementation-specific boundaries.
Do not create a new canonical family solely because two existing families are packaged together.
Every proposed new canonical concept must be labeled single_witness_candidate until independent corroboration.
Standalone heat-pump dryer evidence is not AIO evidence — do not borrow for corroboration.
notCreating: mutations to any other frozen canonical graph

centerpieceQuestion.question: What is the minimum set of new canonical FUNCTIONS — not components — required to represent AIO laundry-combo diagnostics that cannot already be represented by frozen front_load_washer and vented_dryer graphs?
centerpieceQuestion.framing: Wash path reuses front_load_washer. Dry path diverges from vented_dryer. Integration may require a third orchestration function. Packaging alone is insufficient justification.
centerpieceQuestion.disallowedShortcut: Promoting compressor, EVA thermistors, dehumidifying kit, and auto-open door as separate canonical nodes because Samsung tests them

relationshipDiscovery.rule: Establish whether relationships are stable functional contracts or Samsung implementation details before proposing canonical edges

requiredFields: why existing canonical families cannot represent it

queries: compressor refrigerant drying in laundry combo context

excludedFromAioCorroboration.reason: Stacked laundry center — not single-drum AIO
Dual-load washer — no integrated dry in same drum
Optional condenser duct on some FL washers — not full AIO; ventless condensing accessory not heat-pump AIO witness
Safety text references combination washer-dryer — no AIO service architecture ingested
Standalone heat-pump dryer — separate fit-test candidate; not AIO evidence per discovery rules
